name: wrg-sigma-rules
description: Sigma detection rule writing, validation, and conversion for SOC analysts and threat-intel teams. LLM-assisted draft + pySigma validation + multi-backend conversion (Splunk, Elastic, OpenSearch; Wazuh through the Elastic Lucene backend) with logsource-aware processing pipelines. Ships a 330-rule published corpus spanning 16 categories (every MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise tactic plus code review), covering ransomware and threat-actor activity as well as vulnerabilities disclosed in AI/LLM applications and MCP servers.
